monitoring.cadence_proposed: Weekly closest/core; monthly others; event-triggered major releases

competitors.name: Superset
competitors.direction: Parallel agent development with task/worktree/review and remote-host automation.
competitors.chartr_implication: Close the task-to-change loop and retain explicit lifecycle intent.
competitors.watch_triggers: Managed cloud availability, workspace review/automation changes, host recovery semantics.

competitors.name: Paseo
competitors.direction: Cross-device agent control plane with headless execution and contributions across clients.
competitors.chartr_implication: One shared work model for desktop and Companion; broader contracts after a proven core.
competitors.watch_triggers: 0.8 plugin API stabilization, mobile parity, provider adapters and daemon/worktree recovery.
competitors.release_caveat: Inspected 0.8.0-beta.1, published 2026-09-08; stable 0.7.2 observed 2026-09-02. Broader plugin API is experimental/beta.

competitors.name: Emdash
competitors.direction: Task-centered local/remote development from worktree provisioning through PR/CI review.
competitors.chartr_implication: Benchmark the complete user journey and provisioning/cleanup ownership.
competitors.watch_triggers: Verification-to-acceptance workflow, provider capability changes, remote setup friction.

competitors.name: Synara
competitors.direction: Local-first provider threads, handoffs, managed worktrees, verification and review.
competitors.chartr_implication: Transparent handoff context and safe worktree retention; no lossless-context claims.
competitors.watch_triggers: Handoff fidelity, integrated verification, adapter/release quality.

competitors.name: T3 Code
competitors.direction: Integrated provider conversation, change review and cross-device control.
competitors.chartr_implication: Separate runtime activity from work settlement; durable planning remains a candidate distinction.
competitors.watch_triggers: Durable project planning, stable mobile/remote scope, settlement and checkpoint changes.
competitors.release_caveat: Sampled top three releases were nightlies; latest stable version not established by this audit.

competitors.name: bb
competitors.direction: Programmable IDE/software factory with hosts, environments, threads and lifecycle plugins.
competitors.chartr_implication: Use work/run/environment distinctions; extend execution contracts rather than only panes.
competitors.watch_triggers: Stable plugin/environment contracts, parent-child orchestration and desktop maturity.

competitors.name: DeepSeek Harness
competitors.direction: Composable agent harness with event-derived sessions, scopes, tools and profiles.
competitors.chartr_implication: Potential provider and semantics reference; avoid building a competing model/tool loop.
competitors.watch_triggers: Preview API breaks, CLI integration requirements, durable session and subagent semantics.

competitors.name: Moshi
competitors.direction: Phone supervision/input plus hook-bundled desktop interface and SSH-host access.
competitors.chartr_implication: Design useful mobile attention/respond/review and recognize desktop expansion.
competitors.watch_triggers: Actionable approvals/review, desktop changes, transport and host integration.
competitors.evidence_confidence: official product claims; current implementation not audited

competitors.name: Cube
competitors.direction: Desktop workspace plus managed Linux computers and local/cloud agent work.
competitors.chartr_implication: Keep environment replaceable; defer managed compute until local adoption is proven.
competitors.watch_triggers: Current app source publication, cloud continuity/ownership, environment portability.
competitors.evidence_confidence: official product claims; current implementation not audited
competitors.source_caveat: June 16 Collaborator snapshot is historical evidence only; separate cube-releases repo contains distribution material, not current cloud app source.

competitors.name: Soft Machine
competitors.direction: Persistent collaborative cloud environments, clones and agent-managed subworkspaces.
competitors.chartr_implication: Learn reproducible experiment/artifact continuity; do not copy the cloud platform near term.
competitors.watch_triggers: Exit from alpha, environment retention/recovery, public app source or extensibility contracts.
competitors.evidence_confidence: official product claims; current implementation not audited
competitors.source_caveat: Rendered official landing page inspected in browser; release README says app source private. Alpha claims not independently tested.

competitors.name: Superlogical
competitors.direction: Terminal-first durable/composable work across environments, eventually production.
competitors.chartr_implication: Concentrate on development intent/evidence instead of all-work infrastructure.
competitors.watch_triggers: Beta/general availability, source release, structured work APIs, production roadmap.
competitors.evidence_confidence: official product claims; current implementation not audited
competitors.availability_caveat: Site invites beta signups; public preview post text inspected. Embedded demo video not independently evaluated.

competitors.name: Diri
competitors.direction: Compact native Rust/GPUI agent workspace emphasizing state accuracy and continuity.
competitors.chartr_implication: Native alone is not a distinction; build measurable supervision and work-context advantages.
competitors.watch_triggers: Planning/review depth, status reliability, remote/mobile and holder recovery changes.

competitors.name: SSHHIP
competitors.direction: Focused iOS SSH/Mosh multiplexer client with touch-specific command controls.
competitors.chartr_implication: Copy interaction economy and separate session input from multiplexer management.
competitors.watch_triggers: Agent supervision, CommandDial/input workflow, Herdr integration.
competitors.evidence_confidence: official product claims; current implementation not audited

competitors.name: Unpeel
competitors.direction: Native clients around a headless agent-aware terminal host and scoped tooling.
competitors.chartr_implication: Document real continuity levels; differentiate through intent and acceptance around terminals.
competitors.watch_triggers: Planning/review expansion, core takeover, runtime integrations and device access.
competitors.source_license_observed: MIT for public repository; operated Link service separate
competitors.release_caveat: GitHub releases API returned no entries; this is not evidence of no distribution. Core source and docs describe 0.4.4-era behavior.

competitors.name: Git Nimble
competitors.direction: Native macOS Git client with contextual Quick Commit and focused review/staging.
competitors.chartr_implication: Make the default Git plugin task-aware and fast to enter.
competitors.watch_triggers: Agent/task-aware review, contextual repo detection, staging and forge integration.
competitors.evidence_confidence: official product claims; current implementation not audited

competitors.name: Fork
competitors.direction: Mac/Windows Git client with broad history, staging, conflict and rebase tools.
competitors.chartr_implication: Use as correctness/breadth reference; external handoff for advanced operations initially.
competitors.watch_triggers: Task/agent integrations and review/conflict workflow improvements.
competitors.evidence_confidence: official product claims; current implementation not audited
